flashcards.term: Describe the objective, procedure, observation, and principle for Activity 3.3 (To survey neighborhood water collection and identify vector breeding hazards.).
flashcards.phonetic_guide: [Phonetic Guide: describe the objective, procedure, observation, and principle for activity 3.3 (to survey neighborhood water collection and identify vector breeding hazards.).]
flashcards.definition:
Aim: To survey neighborhood water collection and identify vector breeding hazards.
Materials: Survey chart, Pen
Steps: Inspect residential surroundings for stagnant water in coolers, open drains, and discarded tires. Note presence of mosquito larvae. Propose community drainage and larvicidal action.
Observation: Stagnant water harbors breeding larvae of Anopheles and Aedes mosquitoes.
Principle: Eliminating standing water prevents vector reproduction and cuts malaria/dengue transmission.

flashcards.phonetic_guide: [Phonetic Guide: why are antibiotics ineffective against the common cold?]
flashcards.definition: Common cold is caused by viruses. Antibiotics specifically target bacterial cellular structures (like cell walls) and are ineffective against viral entities.

flashcards.term: Detail the holistic pillars required to maintain optimal health according to WHO and traditional health systems.
flashcards.phonetic_guide: [Phonetic Guide: detail the holistic pillars required to maintain optimal health according to who and traditional health systems.]
flashcards.definition: 1. Balanced Nutrition: Consuming adequate carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, and roughage. 2. Hygiene & Sanitation: Personal cleanliness and vector-free surroundings. 3. Physical Exercise: Regular activity strengthening cardiovascular and muscular systems. 4. Vaccination: Timely immunization against communicable diseases. 5. Mental Well-being & Rest: Adequate sleep, stress control, and positive social connections.
